question: Should OpenClaw retire these shipped bundled skills now and designate Sherpa ONNX TTS as an official ClawHub-only plugin in the same release change?
rationale: The code direction supports a leaner core, but deciding which shipped capabilities may disappear, how upgrades are repaired, and which external package and native artifacts receive official trust requires explicit product, release, and security ownership.

options.title: Migration-first retirement
options.body: Publish and verify replacements, add doctor repair for persisted references, authorize the exact dependency graph, and merge only after fresh-install and upgrade proof passes.

options.title: Split Sherpa packaging
options.body: Move the Sherpa external-plugin and official-install work to a focused PR while deferring the broad bundled-skill retirement.

options.title: Keep the shipped bundle
options.body: Close or park this broad branch until a later release owns a complete deprecation and migration plan.

recommendation.title: Migration-first retirement
recommendation.body: Publish and verify replacements, add doctor repair for persisted references, authorize the exact dependency graph, and merge only after fresh-install and upgrade proof passes.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent split-work history, is assigned here, and has already defined the remaining product and packaging decision surface.
